meta.note: Los hechos provienen de los artículos originales enlazados. La IA solo traduce y resume; no genera noticias.

es.title: Noticias de Copyright e Inteligencia Artificial
es.subtitle: Notas publicadas por medios reales de la industria, con liga al artículo original. Sin noticias inventadas.

items.title: Music industry intervenes in Open AI’s big legal battle with newspapers and authors
items.summary: All of the US music industry’s copyright lawsuits against AI companies swing on whether or not AI training is fair use under US law. A big legal battle involving authors, newspapers and Open AI also centres on fair use, and the music industry has now intervened in that case via an amicus brief

items.title: Suno Fires Back Against Apple’s Subpoena Opposition, Doubling Down on Its Push for Information About ‘Current License Negotiations,’ ‘Anti-AI Deal Terms,’ and More
items.summary: Suno is doubling down on its Apple subpoena push, arguing that the information being sought – about Apple Music’s major label licensing talks, “anti-AI deal terms,” and more – is central to its fair use and copyright misuse arguments. The AI music platform took aim at Apple’s motion to quash in a 24-page opposition fil…

items.title: Elvis Presley IP Owners Sue Anthropic Over Allegations of Copyright Infringement
items.summary: Elvis Presley’s rightsholders have sued Anthropic with allegations of copyright infringement over 274 of his songs used to train AI models without permission. AI company Anthropic faces yet another copyright infringement lawsuit, this time filed by the owners of Elvis Presley’s music in a case that accuses the company…

items.title: AI roundup: Lyria lawsuit, Anthropic’s Q3, OpenAI pile-in
items.summary: Big money, big lawsuits, and claims that if AI training isn’t ruled as ‘fair use’ it would “threaten not merely a single industry, but the broader economy” – not to mention hamper cancer research, cybersecurity defences and emergency response systems. It’s quite the day of news in the AI world. The post is from Music A…

items.title: As UMG v. Suno Subpoenas Target the MLC, Multiple Investors, DistroKid, and Now Apple Music, Are Game-Changing Disclosures on the Horizon?
items.summary: As Suno fends off an ever-growing number of music industry copyright complaints, a raft of subpoena showdowns – including the AI platform’s own document and deposition demands – are now in full swing. Does that mean game-changing disclosures are on the horizon? Time will tell, though the current evidence suggests yes.…

items.title: Anthropic sued over Elvis catalog — and the 274-song copyright battle shows the AI industry's 'fair use' excuses are getting old
Suno Says Jason Isbell Lawsuit Over Artist ‘Identities’ Must Be Dismissed: ‘Nothing Unlawful About That’
items.summary: The AI music company has filed its first major response to the novel lawsuit, which accuses it of violating musicians' likeness rights.

items.title: GEMA on AI: ‘The most important thing is we get an output remuneration’
items.summary: Having won an initial ruling against Suno in Germany, collecting society GEMA is considering its future moves in AI music, both in terms of lawsuits and policy lobbying. In an interview for our Music Ally Focus podcast today, general counsel Dr Kai Welp talked about one of its priorities on the latter front. The post i…

items.title: Suno lleva su generador de canciones a ChatGPT y Claude
items.summary: Suno MCP, en beta desde el 28 de octubre, permite crear canciones desde ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini o Cursor, incluso con el plan gratuito y sus créditos.

items.title: Spotify quiere ser el agente musical de ChatGPT y Claude
items.summary: Spotify quiere ser el servicio que eligen los agentes de IA: ya está en ChatGPT, Claude y Muse, y asegura que no comparte datos de escucha con ellos.

items.title: Música con IA: qué puedes hacer con Suno, Udio y Spotify
UMG, Sony, and DistroKid tell court they are ‘working on a resolution’ in dispute over AI music data for Suno case

tip.title: Antes de firmar, revisa la reversión de derechos
tip.body: La pregunta clave de cualquier contrato no es cuánto te dan hoy, sino cuándo y cómo recuperas tu obra. Si no hay cláusula de reversión, estás cediendo por el plazo completo.

tip.title: Before signing, check the reversion clause
tip.body: The key question in any deal isn't what you get today —it's when and how you get your work back. With no reversion clause, you're assigning for the full term.
